Print the Operating Characteristics of BOIN-ET Across Scenarios

Source: R/print.boin_et_oc_multi.R
print.boin_et_oc_multi.Rd

Display the table produced by sim_boin_et_multi, with six rows per scenario.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'boin_et_oc_multi'
print(
  x,
  digits = 1,
  percent = FALSE,
  kable = FALSE,
  kable_format = "pipe",
  ...
)

Arguments

x

An object of class boin_et_oc_multi.

digits

Integer scalar. Number of decimal places. Defaults to 1.

percent

Logical scalar. Express the average numbers of patients, DLTs and responses at each dose as percentages of the trial totals. Defaults to FALSE.

kable

Logical scalar. Print the table with knitr::kable(), for use in R Markdown. Defaults to FALSE.

kable_format

Character scalar. Format passed to knitr::kable(). Defaults to "pipe".

...

Further arguments, currently ignored.

Value

The object x, invisibly.

See also

sim_boin_et_multi

Examples

scenarios <- list(
  list(name = "Monotone",
       p_true = c(0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.25, 0.40),
       p_resp = c(0.05, 0.10, 0.25, 0.40, 0.65, 0.70)),
  list(name = "Peaked",
       p_true = c(0.05, 0.15, 0.25, 0.35, 0.45, 0.55),
       p_resp = c(0.30, 0.70, 0.60, 0.50, 0.40, 0.30))
)
res <- sim_boin_et_multi(
  target = 0.30, target_resp = 0.60, scenarios = scenarios,
  n_cohort = 12, cohort_size = 3, n_trials = 300, seed = 1
)
print(res)

#>                 Patients treated  3.2  3.9  5.9  8.6 11.8  2.5           35.9

#>           Patients with response  1.7 17.3  2.4  0.6  0.1  0.0           22.0
print(res, percent = TRUE)
